# /crav1-match-dump-to-specs

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From a later dump onto existing specs](../../from-match-dump.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-match-dump-to-specs/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Sort a later dump of notes, tickets, old docs, diagrams, or screenshots onto specs that already exist; one dump may cover one slug or many.

A later dump, specs already exist → sort onto those specs (belongs, already there, note, or does not fit), then quote the new bits. A confirmed note is written under `docs/notes/`. Does not ask for a slug first. Does not create a slug. Does not seed `docs/system/`. Fills a missing `glossary.md` only when that folder already exists. New glossary rows are appended. Existing rows are not rewritten. A meaning the source does not state is `to be researched`. That same pass adds what is new to the short description, the diagram, and how the parts connect. It does not rewrite what is already there. Does not plan, implement, or commit.

## Runs when

A later dump; specs already exist. Called by the user.

## Reads

In short: The dump and existing spec folders.

Reads the dump, existing spec folders, skipping `_template`, and `docs/notes/` so the same item is not noted twice.

## Writes

In short: Confirmed new quotes in matching specs, `docs/notes/` for a note, `docs/sources/` for an imported source, the transfer data policy after a yes, research stale marks after a yes, and answer links under open questions.

Writes confirmed new quotes into the matching `spec.md` files, `docs/notes/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md` and `docs/notes/index.md` when the confirmed sort leaves a fact on the Note pile, and a missing `glossary.md` or new glossary rows only when `docs/system/` already exists. When a confirmed quote comes from an imported source, also writes `docs/sources/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>/`, following `crav1-add-to-spec` `references/sources.md`. That check may write the transfer data policy after a yes. Cursor: `.cursor/rules/crav1-transfer-data-policy.mdc`. Claude Code project: `.claude/rules/crav1-transfer-data-policy.md`. It never writes a secrets choice into that file. For a mail, it lists each embedded image, inline or attached. It recommends convert to text when the image is a diagram, a table, or text that can be reproduced exactly, and compress otherwise. It asks once before the source folder is written. Auto-accept applies to those recommendations only when the transfer data policy clearly covers them. A listed `repos.md` edit keeps `Synced at` and does not set it. After a kept quote, compares it with `docs/research/*.md` and `## Research findings` on the specs it touches, including notes those findings link to, following `crav1-add-to-spec` `references/research-stale.md`. A clear contradiction or an answered open question is marked stale only after the user says yes. An unclear case is not marked. It may draft a revisit request for the note's owner. It does not send it. A clear answer to a spec open question is linked under that question with the confirmed sort, and a source that shows a question being asked writes its `Asked:` date, following `crav1-add-to-spec` `references/open-questions.md`. An unclear or partial answer is shown and the question stays open.

## Does not

Leaves leftovers, `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, and other landscape files alone unless the user picks apply. Does not commit.

Limits and exceptions: creates no slug and seeds no `docs/system/`. A confirmed Note writes `docs/notes/` and does not ask what kind of note it is. An item already noted is not written again. The research question is not the landscape apply question.
